name: backfill_prow_job_runs_from_old
description: Backfill rows from prow_job_runs_old missing in the partitioned production table for the last 120 days by business timestamp
query: INSERT INTO prow_job_runs (id, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, prow_job_id, prow_job_release, cluster, gcs_bucket, url, test_failures, failed, infrastructure_failure, known_failure, succeeded, timestamp, duration, overall_result, labels, test_flakes) SELECT o.id, o.created_at, o.updated_at, o.deleted_at, o.prow_job_id, o.prow_job_release, o.cluster, o.gcs_bucket, o.url, o.test_failures, o.failed, o.infrastructure_failure, o.known_failure, o.succeeded, o.timestamp, o.duration, o.overall_result, o.labels, o.test_flakes FROM prow_job_runs_old o LEFT JOIN prow_job_runs n ON o.id = n.id AND o.prow_job_release = n.prow_job_release AND o.timestamp = n.timestamp WHERE o.timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '120 days' AND n.id IS NULL ORDER BY o.created_at, o.id

name: backfill_prow_job_run_annotations_from_old
description: Backfill rows from prow_job_run_annotations_old missing in the partitioned production table for the last 120 days by business timestamp
query: INSERT INTO prow_job_run_annotations (id, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, prow_job_run_id, key, value, prow_job_run_release, prow_job_run_timestamp) SELECT o.id, o.created_at, o.updated_at, o.deleted_at, o.prow_job_run_id, o.key, o.value, o.prow_job_run_release, o.prow_job_run_timestamp FROM prow_job_run_annotations_old o LEFT JOIN prow_job_run_annotations n ON o.id = n.id AND o.prow_job_run_release = n.prow_job_run_release AND o.prow_job_run_timestamp = n.prow_job_run_timestamp WHERE o.prow_job_run_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '120 days' AND n.id IS NULL ORDER BY o.created_at, o.id

name: backfill_prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_from_old
description: Backfill rows from prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_old missing in the partitioned production table for the last 120 days by business timestamp
query: INSERT INTO prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests (prow_job_run_id, prow_pull_request_id, prow_job_run_release, prow_job_run_timestamp) SELECT o.prow_job_run_id, o.prow_pull_request_id, o.prow_job_run_release, o.prow_job_run_timestamp FROM prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_old o LEFT JOIN prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests n ON o.prow_job_run_id = n.prow_job_run_id AND o.prow_pull_request_id = n.prow_pull_request_id AND o.prow_job_run_release = n.prow_job_run_release AND o.prow_job_run_timestamp = n.prow_job_run_timestamp WHERE o.prow_job_run_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '120 days' AND n.prow_job_run_id IS NULL ORDER BY o.prow_job_run_timestamp, o.prow_job_run_id
